stories.title: 급락 하루 만에 뛰는 삼성전자·SK하이닉스…증권가 “내년 영업익 1000조 돌파” [주가동향]
stories.body:
◆…사진=연합뉴스 제공. 

 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 전날 급락을 딛고 장 초반 나란히 상승하고 있다. 미국 반도체주 강세로 매수 심리가 되살아난 가운데 내년 두 회사의 연간 영업이익이 합계 1000조원을 넘어설 것이라는 증권가 전망도 나왔다.

 4일 오전 9시3분 기준 삼성전자는 전 거래일보다 8000원(3.64%) 상승한 22만7500원에 거래되고 있다. SK하이닉스는 7만4000원(5.29%) 오른 147만2000원을 나타냈다. 전날 각각 4%, 5% 떨어진 뒤 하루 만에 반등에 나섰다.

 간밤 미국 시장에서 반도체주에 매수세가 유입된 것이 국내 주가에도 힘을 보탰다. 3일(현지시간) 뉴욕증시 주요 지수는 중간선거를 둘러싼 경계 속에 방향이 엇갈렸지만 AMD는 실적 기대감에 3.65% 올랐다.

 브로드컴과 엔비디아도 각각 3.07%, 2.29% 상승했다. 메모리 업체인 샌디스크와 마이크론은 각각 4.78%, 2.58% 뛰었다.

 국내에서는 메모리 업황 개선에 따른 이익 확대 전망이 투자심리를 뒷받침했다.

 KB증권은 이날 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 2027년 영업이익을 각각 640조2000억원, 470조3000억원으로 추산했다. 합계 1110조5000억원으로 올해보다 67% 늘어날 것이라는 예상이다.

 올해 4분기부터 가파른 실적 증가세가 나타날 것으로 봤다. 삼성전자 영업이익은 전년 동기 대비 539% 증가한 128조원, SK하이닉스는 441% 늘어난 104조원으로 제시했다.

 두 회사의 분기 영업이익 추정치를 합친 232조원은 지난해 코스피 전체 상장사의 연간 영업이익 244조원에 근접하는 규모다.

 이 같은 전망의 근거는 메모리 출하 증가와 가격 상승, 고대역폭메모리(HBM)의 세대교체 때문이다.

South African Breweries says rising food and fuel costs are cutting beer purchases among poorer consumers
stories.body:
South African Breweries, the country’s largest brewer, said on Monday, November 2, that rising food and fuel costs are forcing many lower-income consumers to cut back on beer purchases, adding pressure to sales even as demand for some higher-priced brands remains strong.
Richard Rivett-Carnac, SAB’s chief executive, said household budgets are being squeezed by spending on essentials such as transport and food, leaving less money for discretionary items. “The lower-income consumer is under enormous pressure in the country,” he said.
His comments came after parent company AB InBev reported third-quarter results showing that beer volume growth in South Africa lagged the broader industry, even though the group posted its highest third-quarter volumes in the country. stories.body:

Vertiv ( VRT ) jumped 6% today, Election Day, after Bernstein said the political threat to US data-center construction is smaller than the market thinks.
In a note after Monday’s close, Bernstein kept its Outperform rating and $376 target on Vertiv. It also named Eaton ( ETN ) , GE Vernova ( GEV ) and Quanta Services ( PWR ) among its other picks.
Bernstein counts 244 gigawatts, about 56% of the 433-gigawatt US data-center pipeline, as exposed to political risk.
But it expects the jobs and tax revenue that data centers bring to soften elected officials’ positions. Where the politics do bite, Bernstein expects developers to pay a bigger share of electricity and grid-upgrade costs. It sees that cost as relatively immaterial.

stories.title: Marvell to Acquire Lumentum in $115 Billion AI Connectivity Deal
stories.body:
Marvell Technology and Lumentum today announced that they have entered into a definitive agreement for Marvell to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock transaction.
Under the terms of the agreement, Lumentum stockholders will receive a fixed exchange ratio of 4.500 shares of Marvell common stock for each share of Lumentum common stock they own.
The transaction has an implied enterprise value of $115 billion for Lumentum, representing approximately $1,132 per share of Lumentum common stock and a premium of approximately 23.9% based on each company’s unaffected closing share price as of October 28, 2026, the last trading day before market speculation regarding a potential transaction began. Post-closing, current Marvell stockholders will own approximately 67% of the combined company on a fully diluted basis, while Lumentum stockholders will own approximately 33%.
